shortDescription: The International Monetary Fund approved a $1.9 billion financing program for Bolivia, including an immediate $214 million disbursement, according to Bloomberg.The package is designed to help President Rodrigo Paz reverse a sharp economic slump.

title: IMF Approves $1.9 Billion Bolivia Program for Paz Reforms
